evidence_proposition: On a two-period chain whose y intercept shifts between periods with x unchanged, the mean-difference mechanism-change detection flags y at significance 0.05.
limitations: A qualitative detection outcome on one seeded two-period dataset: no statistic, p-value, power or false-positive rate is derived or compared with an independent calculation, and the fixture's changed list for x is not asserted. By-construction truth of which mechanism changed is not a numeric closed form. No calibration.
